# Luca Scattolin

> Portfolio of Luca Scattolin, a 3D Technical Artist & Creative Technologist working across real-time 3D pipelines, interactive experiences, renders and configurators.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lucascattolin.com/): Profile, skills and project overview.
- [Vivatech](https://lucascattolin.com/vivatech.html): Real-time interactive installation built with TouchDesigner and Unreal Engine, showcased at Vivatech in Paris.
- [Pipeline Projects](https://lucascattolin.com/pipeline-projects.html): In-house tools built for the 3D R&D team at Thélios - Maya prep toolkit, Unreal render automation, Omniverse look-dev panel and PowerPoint deck generators. Redrawn interfaces, no proprietary data.
- [Homelab](https://lucascattolin.com/homelab.html): Personal self-hosted homelab project - hardware wiring diagram and service map.
- [Privacy](https://lucascattolin.com/privacy.html): Privacy notice.
